deviations-entry.justification: Tool false positive. The reported "conversion from 'bool' to 'bool &'" is the binding of a bool lvalue to the forwarding-reference parameter (Args&&) of std::make_unique. Reference binding is not a conversion (C++ [dcl.init.ref]); the value is forwarded unchanged to a bool constructor parameter. No integral or arithmetic use of bool occurs. Avoiding std::make_unique would require raw new (Rule 21.6.2).

DEV-LOG-001. The process-wide logger Logger::instance()::s_instance is a function-local static so that it is created on first use, also when used during static initialisation of other translation units (no initialisation-order dependency); its initialisation is thread-safe ([stmt.dcl]/4); and it is destroyed, after flushing, at normal program exit.
deviations-entry.background: Alternatives rejected: a namespace-scope or static-member object violates Rule 6.7.2 and has unspecified cross-TU initialisation order; allocating it with new violates Rule 21.6.1/21.6.2 and is never flushed at exit.

deviations-entry.justification: Tool false positive. In chw_imagenet() and chw_01(), c * NET_H * NET_W is evaluated with c bounded by the loop condition c < 3 and NET_H, NET_W constexpr (AutoDrive::NET_H, AutoDrive::NET_W). The maximum value is 2 * NET_H * NET_W (2 * 512 * 1024 = 1 048 576), far below INT_MAX. CodeQL does not propagate the loop bound.
deviations-entry.scope: modules/models/src/inference.cpp, channel offset c * NET_H * NET_W in the CHW conversion loops only.

deviations-entry.justification: Tool false positive. C - 4 is evaluated only after the guard if (C <= 4) return, so C is in [5, INT64_MAX] and C - 4 is in [1, INT64_MAX - 4]; the int64_t subtraction cannot overflow or underflow.

The AutoSpeed output tensor has shape [1, C, N] (channel-major); element (k, n) is at data[k * N + n] with 0 <= k < C and 0 <= n < N. Every index is at most C * N - 1, the element count of the tensor allocated by ONNX Runtime, so it is representable in int64_t. 4 + c is at most C - 1 because c < num_classes = C - 4. (AutoSpeed: C = 8, N = 10752, maximum index 86015.)
deviations-entry.background: CodeQL cannot bound the runtime tensor dimensions C and N. The bound relies on ONNX Runtime returning a shape consistent with the allocated tensor data.
deviations-entry.scope: modules/models/src/auto_speed.cpp, tensor index expressions k * N + n and (4 + c) * N + n in the decode loop only.

deviations-entry.justification: init_gstreamer_once()::once is a function-local std::once_flag that guards the process-wide gst_init() call. It must have static storage duration so that it is shared by all WebRTCStreamer instances and threads and outlives every call. std::once_flag has a constexpr constructor (constant initialisation, no cross-TU initialisation-order dependency), and std::call_once makes the one-time initialisation thread-safe. Function-local scope limits its visibility to this function.
deviations-entry.background: Alternatives rejected: a namespace-scope or static-member flag violates Rule 6.7.2 and widens visibility; a per-instance flag would call gst_init() once per streamer instead of once per process; relying on gst_init() being safe to call repeatedly would change the logic and depend on GStreamer internals.
